remarks: A Rare Gem! This exceptional 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo features a spacious flex room and expansive loft, offering the versatility of a much larger home. Step inside to soaring vaulted ceilings and an open-concept layout filled with natural light and style.  The updated kitchen boasts granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a layout ideal for both daily living and entertaining. The flex room off the main living space is perfect as a home office, guest room, or creative studio. Upstairs, the loft overlooks the living area and can serve as a media room, lounge, fitness space, or second office.  The primary bedroom offers comfort and functionality with a generous layout and a custom walk-in closet system. Step onto your private balcony to enjoy morning coffee or evening relaxation.  Additional highlights include interior garage parking, a secure package room, on-site gym, and a welcoming lobby/lounge area. Ideally located minutes from shopping, dining, the Rowayton train station, and the Darien/New Canaan lines for easy commuting.  More than a condo-this is a lifestyle upgrade. Don't miss this rare opportunity!
